name: quality-compressor
title: Quality Compressor
author: holunder
description:
Compresses identical raw materials of lower quality into one item of the next quality tier. A predictable alternative to recycler loops, paid for with a lot of power.

Verdichtet gleiche Rohstoffe niedriger Qualität zu einem Item der nächsten Qualitätsstufe. Planbare Alternative zur Recycler-Schleife.
